title: Spirit of Wisdom
definition: Spirit of Wisdom describes the Holy Spirit's ministry of giving God's people spiritual understanding, discernment, and wise obedience.
summary: The Holy Spirit gives wisdom that is rooted in God's truth and centered on Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the wisdom of God, and the Spirit helps believers know and walk in His wisdom.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit gives wisdom that is more than human intelligence. He helps believers understand God's truth, discern good from evil, and apply Scripture faithfully.

This wisdom is Christ-centered. The Spirit does not simply help people make better worldly decisions; He teaches them to live under Christ's lordship.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often have information without wisdom. This doctrine matters because believers need spiritual understanding for real life, suffering, relationships, and ministry.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray for wisdom from the Spirit. Before making decisions, seek Scripture, counsel, prayer, and what honors Christ.

relatedTopics: Guidance and Conviction of the Holy Spirit
